text:
Nina: BREAKING: Maple the hedgehog has been promoted to Office Plant Ambassador. photos: https://img.internal/maple-pot-ambassador.jpg :seedling: :hedgehog: 
Carlos: wow the tiny scarf and the tiny watering can are the content I signed up for. :joy: 
Jess: did we just cross into 'cute municipal services'? Maple clearly enforces soil moisture codes. 
Riley: also, is that a tiny hard hat? health & safety approved. 
Nina: its a bandana but soft hat energy. shes very serious about her inspections. 
Carlos: can confirm, maple refused a succulent with limp leaves. very particular. 
Jess: vote: should we add a maple emoji to the team reactions? :ballot_box_with_ballot: 
Riley: yes. also, photo request: close-up of the supervision face. 
Nina: posted a macro: https://img.internal/maple-close.jpg 10/10 judgmental brow. 
ops-bot: FYI: office pets policy reminder: please register pets with People Ops before bringing them to HQ. :memo: 
Nina: noted — Maple already has an HR file called 'hazardous cuteness'. 
Carlos: someone make a plaque that says 'Maple: In Charge of Photosynthesis Compliance' 
Jess: I made a terrible mockup in 3 minutes: https://img.internal/maple-plaque-mock.png 
Riley: stunning. apply for swag. 
Carlos: also curious — does Maple accept snack bribes? will bring sunflower seeds. 
Nina: she prefers tiny pieces of apple. sunflower seeds too loud. 
Jess: GIF: https://img.internal/maple-waddle.gif 100% morale booster. 
Riley: saving as "official meeting opening" animation. 
Nina: last update: Maple fell asleep halfway through inspecting a pothos; full snore. photo proof: https://img.internal/maple-snooze.jpg 
Carlos: reaction: :heart_eyes: 
Jess: ok next watercooler theme suggestion: 'pets who double as interior decorators' — whos in? 
Riley: in. 
ops-bot: Poll created: "Bring a pet + a decor item to watercooler show-and-tell next Friday?" Options: Yes / No / Virtual only. 
Nina: voted Yes. 
Carlos: voted Yes. 
Jess: voted Virtual only (my cat is chaotic). 
Riley: voted Yes. 
Nina: Maples closing statement: a tiny paw tap and a very dignified sniff. end of inspection.
